{"code":"def transform(g):
    a=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    # complete the two side guide-lines around the rising colored form
    full=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==6 for x in r)]
    stop=min(full) if full else h
    # orientation inferred from upper colored mass
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j]==6 for i in range(1,stop))]
    l=min(cols) if cols else 0; r=max(cols) if cols else w-1
    # use outer boundaries; colors are reversed for right-rising forms
    c1,c2=(4,9) if l==0 and (sum(g[i][0]==6 for i in range(h))>sum(g[i][r]==6 for i in range(h))) else (9,4)
    for i in range(1,stop):
        a[i][l]=c1; a[i][r]=c2
    return a"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    # marker columns: left edge and the column just beyond the width of the next-to-bottom band
    # infer the broad staircase's penultimate row extent
    row=g[h-2]
    inds=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]
    right=(max(inds)+1) if inds else w-1
    # alternating marker orientation according to number of non-background rows in the lower object
    n=sum(1 for i in range(1,h) if 6 in g[i])
    lc,rc=(4,9) if n%2 else (9,4)
    first=next((i for i in range(1,h) if g[i][0]==6),h)
    for i in range(1,first): g[i][0]=lc
    for i in range(1,h-1):
        if g[i][right]==1: g[i][right]=rc
    return g"}
